method: Each item was inspected on a standalone crop rendered from the original PDF with no parser overlay (tools/goldset/render_review_crops.py). Gold geometry, header depth, merge spans and column roles were then checked against the page's own text and vector ruling. Parser output was consulted only afterwards, to classify failures; no gold decision was copied from a parser box.

corrections.reason: The PINS ** / DIM dimension table inside the package drawing is a real 3x5 table; the v1 negative covered it, so the negative could not distinguish a drawing hit from a table hit.

Headerless 5x2 dimension-description table under the TAPE DIMENSIONS figure; v1 negative N03 covered its right column. Cell borders are axis-aligned quadrilateral outlines, so the item uses component: null and builds ruling from quad edges.
The old box included the real P13-T02 table starting at y=213.5; the negative now stops at the figure bottom (y=208.0).

corrections.change: all bboxes and kinds re-derived from the rendered page
corrections.reason: Five of eight v1 negatives reproduced a parser prediction exactly (MICRF103-N02, DS10CP152-N01, CY29FCT520-N01/N02/N03); three reproduced a rule component (MICRF103-N01, DS10CP152-N02, DS10CP152-N03). This is annotation provenance leakage. Every negative was checked against the rendered page and re-drawn; CY29FCT520-N03 was retained only because the parser box coincides exactly with the drawing extents 65.8/106.8/566.2/475.6 measured from the page.

corrections.change: negative_kind layout -> prose; extent extended to cover FEATURES and DESCRIPTION
corrections.reason: The v1 box ended at y=173.9 (the parser's FEATURES heading box) and omitted the DESCRIPTION prose; APPLICATIONS starts at y=338.
The v1 box was the parser's 76.6/112.9/486.5/234.3 prediction and covered only part of the pinout; the actual top/side view spans 397.1/74.8/493.6/256.6.

corrections.change: header text corrected from duplicated overprint
corrections.reason: The PDF overprints the UNIT word twice at identical coordinates; the annotation lattice concatenated it as 'UNIT UNIT'. Identical word tuples are now de-duplicated, giving the printed label 'UNIT'.

open_questions: DS10CP152-P13-T02 is fully ruled but drawn as quadrilateral cell outlines; the frozen parser and the rule lattice both ignore 'qu' edges, so this table is a genuine detector miss rather than a gold artefact.

CY29FCT520-P06-T01 column 1 has no printed header label; its 'condition' role is a content-based decision (Data / I), not header attribution. It stays out of header attribution and counts as mapped for role accuracy.
CY29FCT520-P10-T01 labels the dimension column through a diagonal split header cell; the gold keeps one header cell with text 'PINS ** / DIM' and three logical columns.
